_comment: TEMPLATE for Kestrel - install with `bash tools/install-hooks.sh`, never copy by hand. It substitutes __OPTIMIZER_TOOLS__ for this repo's absolute tools/ path and MERGES these entries into the session root's settings file (entries tagged 'optimizer-checkpoint-hooks' are the only ones ever replaced; other repos' hooks, permissions and env survive). Scoped to THIS repo only - never a glob over sibling directories. Claude Code on the web does not load hooks from a repo's own .claude/settings.json when the repo sits under a shared session root, which is why the installer targets the root. When the repo itself is the session root (the normal single-repo case) the committed .claude/settings.json is read directly.
